name: coveragepy_f5eb_public_delivery_v1
purpose: 交付固定公开题面，运行公开API的分支JSON复现及原公开JSON测试；不做求解修改。

steps.command: cd /testbed && id && python -c 'import sys, coverage, pytest; print(sys.executable); print(sys.version); print(coverage.__file__); print(pytest.__version__)'

cd /testbed && python - <<'PYCODE'
import json, os, tempfile, coverage
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as work:
    source = os.path.join(work, 'demo.py')
    with open(source, 'w') as f:
        f.write('flag = True\nif flag:\n    x = 1\nelse:\n    x = 2\n')
    cov = coverage.Coverage(branch=True, config_file=False, data_file=os.path.join(work, '.coverage'))
    cov.start()
    with open(source) as f:
        exec(compile(f.read(), source, 'exec'), {})
    cov.stop()
    report = os.path.join(work, 'coverage.json')
    cov.json_report(outfile=report)
    with open(report) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    print(json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True))

cd /testbed && python -m pytest -o addopts="" -p no:cacheprovider --color=no -rfE tests/test_json.py
